subject: Error when deploying the demo application (Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request)

messages.author: b48728584f437b83
messages.subject: Error when deploying the demo application (Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request)
parts:
Hi,

A few days ago, I have tried deploying the demo application (as described in the Getting Started Guide) and it was OK.

But now I have troubles when deploying (again) this demo applicaiton. When I run the R command deployApp() I get this new error message (while the first time I deployed it it did not happen) :
Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request

Do you have any idea what this error message means and how to solve the problem?

Thanks a lot,
Dominique

parts:
Dominique,

Can you send the full output from your R session when you ran deployApp?

There is some restrictions on the name of the application that can be deployed. The name defaults the current working directory. 

-Andy

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error when deploying the demo application (Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request)
parts:
Dominique,

I just double checked it looks like you are indeed hitting the application name restrictions. Application names must be between 4 and 64 characeters, and can only contain letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. By default deployApp uses the name of the current directory as the application name. You can override this using the appName parameter to deployApp()

For example:

deployApp(appName="myapp")
